note: The 14-day starter routine. One task a day, each under 30 seconds. Tasks build cues, places and reflection; none ever asks anyone to drink more.

tasks.title: Pick a cue for your first glass
tasks.body: Habits stick to things you already do. Choose a moment you never miss.
tasks.sentence: When I {answer}, I'll fill my glass too.

tasks.title: Give your bottle a home
tasks.body: Water you can see gets drunk. Pick where your bottle will live.

tasks.title: Fill tomorrow's bottle tonight
tasks.body: Fill a bottle before bed and leave it where you'll see it when you wake up.

tasks.title: Pair a glass with a meal
tasks.body: Meals happen every day, which makes them strong cues.
tasks.sentence: When I {answer}, I'll have a glass of water with it.

tasks.title: What made it easy yesterday?
tasks.body: Noticing what works is how routines get easier.

tasks.title: Take water with you
tasks.body: Pack your bottle or tumbler the next time you head out.

tasks.title: Make water the easy choice
tasks.body: Put water somewhere you pass often.

tasks.title: A cue for the afternoon
tasks.body: Afternoons are when many people forget. Pick a moment that already happens.
tasks.sentence: When I {answer}, I'll drink some water.
options: stand up after sitting a while

tasks.title: When would a reminder help most?
tasks.body: Later on, WaterBuddy can send one gentle reminder a day. Pick the time it would actually help, or none.

tasks.title: Try water a new way
tasks.body: Plain water can taste different. Try one today, if you like.

tasks.title: Plan for a hot or busy day
tasks.body: Heat and busy days make water easy to forget. Decide now, so you don't have to then.
tasks.sentence: On a hot or busy day, I'll {answer}.
options: have a glass before I go out

tasks.title: How automatic is your first glass?
tasks.body: There's no right answer. It's just for you to see the change over time.

tasks.title: Choose your last call
tasks.body: WaterBuddy stops asking two hours before you sleep, so drinking late never keeps you up. When do you usually go to sleep?

tasks.title: Look back at your two weeks
tasks.body: What will you keep doing? Write a line for future you.
tasks.placeholder: Keep the bottle by my bed…
